overview_description.description:
Sodic is a real estate development company that provides market awars-winning large scale developments.

Incorporated in 1996, SODIC is one of Egypt’s largest publicly listed real estate development companies with a market capitalisation of over EGP 5.5 billion. SODIC is currently developing a number of Egypt’s large scale and award-winning developments including residential, leisure, retail and corporate projects within mixed-use environments. SODIC has developed over 5.8 million square metres of its 9.4 million square metre land bank and employs over 450 staff directly as well as 10,000 indirectly.

about_short_description.short_description: Sodic is a real estate development company that provides market awars-winning large scale developments.

product.name: Residential Developments
product.description: Residential communities and properties, including apartments, villas, chalets, and serviced apartments across West Cairo, East Cairo, and Egypt’s North Coast.

product.name: Mixed-Use Community Development
product.description: Planning and development of integrated communities that combine residential, commercial, retail, medical, hospitality, education, and leisure uses.

product.name: Office Developments
product.description: Office buildings and business parks for startups, growing companies, and corporate headquarters in East and West Cairo.

product.name: Retail Spaces
product.description: Retail and food-and-beverage spaces available for lease within SODIC’s mixed-use communities in Cairo and the North Coast.

product.name: Medical Facilities
product.description: Community healthcare spaces comprising clinics, laboratories, diagnostic centers, pharmacies, radiology services, and hospital facilities.

product.name: Hospitality Developments
product.description: Hotels, serviced apartments, restaurants, and hospitality-led coastal and urban destinations within SODIC developments.
